resources.string: Long-press the map or add a zone at its centre. Choose a circle or quadrilateral; Edit contour lets you move, add and remove vertices. Apply returns to the form; Save zone commits changes. Start manually enables GPS monitoring: inside any zone the walk finishes, outside all zones it starts. Three accepted fixes over at least five seconds confirm a transition. Monitoring continues inside zones. STOP disables it until you start manually again. No restart after reboot or force stop is promised. Without zones, recording remains manual.
Inside a spawn zone · walk finished, GPS monitoring continues
Confirming zone transition · GPS monitoring continues
No spawn zones yet. Long-press the map or add a zone at the map centre.
Enter a name of 1–80 characters without line breaks or control characters.
Enter a finite radius from 1 to 100,000 metres.
Enter valid coordinates. The whole zone must fit between 85.05112878° S and N.
Up to 500 zones can be saved. Delete a zone before adding another.
Could not read or save zones. Existing data has not been intentionally replaced.
Delete zone “%1$s”? Routes, photos and explored areas will remain.
Change position and size by moving points in the map editor. Converting to a circle replaces this contour.
Drag vertices to reshape. Enable Add point, then tap or drag an edge. Pinch to zoom. Apply returns to the form without saving.
The contour must have at least 3 distinct points, a nonzero area and no self-intersections. The invalid move was not applied.
